title: 防災工学Ⅱ
subtitle: Disaster Prevention Engineering II
keywords: Geo-disaster 2.Geology and geomorphology 3.Earthquake 4.Heavy rain 5.National high way bridge design instruction
educationalGoal: This course aims to provide a basic knowledge of present seismic design methods, such as seismic coefficient method. Secondary, Student will learn the mecahnism for slope failure or debris flow at short time heavy rain, and relationship with geology and geomorphology.
advice: Earthquake 1. Mechanism of earthquake around Japan. 2. Comparison of seismic indexes and relationship with damages. 3. Fourier analysis 4. Seismic coefficient method in national high way design book. 5. Multiple reflection theory 6. Simple estimation method for liquefaction 7. Slope stability at earthquake 8. Underground structure at earthquake Geo-disaster 1. Slope failure and debris flow at short time heavy rain 2. Present development of laws and their problems. 3. Counter measure against geo-disaster.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of Soil Mechanics I and II, Geotechnical analysis are required. Basis of Mechanics and Fourier transfer are also needed.
